lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots to form a coordinate-like grid on the anterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single horizontal linear feature is visible above the branchial region, characterized by a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex vermiculated pattern of interconnected white lines and small spots is present on the rostrum and dorsal head surface anterior to the gill slits.
